下面是一个组合界面，所有控件都能从 `root` 这一棵结构树到达；`ask` 只生成可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[note,form,result,chart,table,ask,reset])
$a: number = 2
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
note = Callout(title="合成数学示例", text="以下数值均为合成示例，仅用于演示参数变化对线性函数的影响。", tone="tip")
form = Form(title="函数参数", children=[aInput,bInput,toggle])
aInput = Slider(label="斜率 a", bind=$a, min=-5, max=5, step=0.5)
bInput = NumberField(label="偏移 b", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset, required=true, step=0.5)
toggle = Switch(label="启用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x = 5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u", digits=2)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="合成数学示例：y = a*x + (useOffset ? b : 0)", xLabel="x", yLabel="y", unit="u")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":0},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":2}])
ask = Button(label="准备解释草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请解释这些参数如何影响 x = 5 时的结果 y。这是合成数学示例。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="本地重置", action=Reset())
```

默认参数下，`a=2`、`b=1`、偏移启用，因此 `x=5` 时的结果 `y=11 u`。关闭“启用偏移 b”时，`b` 输入框隐藏并保留原值，结果变为 `10 u`。
